query: Create an HD wallet with Ethereum and Solana using the Turnkey API
expected_behavior: Checks for existing wallets first with POST /public/v1/query/list_wallets
Shows the POST /public/v1/submit/create_wallet endpoint with correct JSON body
Uses correct address formats and derivation paths for both chains
Uses CURVE_SECP256K1 for Ethereum and CURVE_ED25519 for Solana

query: List all wallet accounts for my wallet via the API
expected_behavior: Uses POST /public/v1/query/list_wallet_accounts
Includes walletId in the request body
Does NOT create a new wallet

query: Add a Bitcoin Taproot address to my existing wallet
expected_behavior: Uses POST /public/v1/submit/create_wallet_accounts endpoint
Uses ADDRESS_FORMAT_BITCOIN_MAINNET_P2TR with CURVE_SECP256K1
Uses BIP-86 derivation path m/86'/0'/0'/0/0

query: Export my wallet mnemonic using the Turnkey API
expected_behavior: Uses POST /public/v1/submit/export_wallet with walletId and targetPublicKey
Describes client-side HPKE decryption of the export bundle
Mentions HPKE key pair prerequisite

query: Create a wallet with addresses for Bitcoin, Ethereum, and Cosmos via the API
expected_behavior: Uses POST /public/v1/submit/create_wallet
Includes all three chains with correct curves, paths, and address formats
Uses ADDRESS_FORMAT_BITCOIN_MAINNET_P2WPKH or P2TR for Bitcoin
Shows complete JSON body with the accounts array

query: Get details about a specific wallet by its ID using the Turnkey API
expected_behavior: Uses POST /public/v1/query/get_wallet
Includes walletId in the request body
Does NOT use list_wallets when only one wallet is needed

query: Rename my wallet to 'production-hot-wallet' using the API
expected_behavior: Uses POST /public/v1/submit/update_wallet with walletId and new walletName
Shows the new wallet name in the request body
Returns an activity response with ACTIVITY_TYPE_UPDATE_WALLET

query: Delete two wallets from my organization via the Turnkey API
expected_behavior: Uses POST /public/v1/submit/delete_wallets
Shows walletIds as an array in the request body
Mentions that deletion is permanent

query: Get a specific wallet account by its address
expected_behavior: Uses POST /public/v1/query/get_wallet_account
Includes address in the request body
Does NOT use list_wallet_accounts when only one account is needed

query: Export a single Ethereum account's private key from my wallet, not the whole mnemonic
expected_behavior: Uses POST /public/v1/submit/export_wallet_account with address and targetPublicKey
Explains the difference between export_wallet (mnemonic) and export_wallet_account (single key)
Describes HPKE decryption of the export bundle on the client side

query: Remove specific accounts from my wallet
expected_behavior: Uses POST /public/v1/submit/delete_wallet_accounts
Shows walletAccountIds as an array in the request body
Mentions that deletion is permanent

query: Rename my wallet and then delete an old wallet I no longer need
expected_behavior: Uses POST /public/v1/submit/update_wallet with walletId and new walletName
Uses POST /public/v1/submit/delete_wallets with walletIds array
Mentions that deletion is permanent

query: Get details about a specific wallet account and then delete it
expected_behavior: Uses POST /public/v1/query/get_wallet_account with address parameter
Uses POST /public/v1/submit/delete_wallet_accounts with walletAccountIds array
Does not confuse get_wallet_account with get_wallet or list_wallet_accounts
